_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wena ule muthu wakwela {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Kazithu kwenu kukwela kumwena mithatu kwa mstari (kwa mpimo, kwa urefu, kwa diagonal) pa bodo.
Pa nthawi ya kwenu, wena wasankha nambari ya mraba (0-8) mwenu wakutaka kubeka chapa ya kwenu.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' wakubeka chapa ya kwenu kwa katikati ya bodo.
Kwa muthu wakwela {player_id}, wena ule '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wenu ule '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kengele ya ndundu ewandikutiwa si ye lebaya.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selu halali. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Muthu wakwela {player_id} wakabeka chapa yao ({symbol}) kwa selu {cell}.
